title: ChatGPT AI Web Traffic Share Rises to 56.4% in September

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
OpenAI's leading chatbot regained market momentum and expanded its hold on the generative assistant web market over the last quarter. ChatGPT held 56.4% of website traffic share in September 2026, continuing a steady climb from 53.7% in April, according to Similarweb. Google's Gemini trailed with a 25.0% share, while Anthropic's Claude reached 9.6%, representing a significant increase from the shares of other competitors like DeepSeek and Grok.

The recent growth for ChatGPT is a partial recovery from a 71.8% traffic share it held in October 2025. Conversely, Gemini has seen its share slip from a peak of 26.7% in April, a growth phase credited to the launch of Gemini 3. Other tools like DeepSeek and Copilot maintain smaller footprints, holding 3.4% and 1.5% of the web traffic market respectively.

selectedTweets.bestBit: Earlier growth last year was a result of Gemini 3 success in particular
selectedTweets.text:
ChatGPT vs Gemini 👀

ChatGPT seems to be on a steady growth again for the past 4 months in terms of web traffic share. 

> ChatGPT went up from 53% to 56% while it is no near 71% it had a year ago. 

> Gemini went down only from 26% to 25%; Earlier growth last year was a result of Gemini 3 success in particular. 

> Claude is definitely a sleeping beast over here. If Anthropic will start looking at general consumers as they do at developers, this chart would change quite quickly. 

I also feel like average LTV for these users is quite high and majority of people can react to the dynamic of AI progress.

Will we see another big change on this chart any time soon?
